verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an open-source agent framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents CrewAI's own telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The observability items describe user-facing tracing and monitoring of agents, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
